fields.name: Descending
documentation: Events are sorted in descending order (longest time remaining to shortest).

fields.name: Ascending
documentation: Events are sorted in ascending order (shortest time remaining to longest).

tables.name: EncounterTimelineEventSource
documentation: Enumeration of all encounter timeline event sources.

fields.name: Encounter
documentation: Source used for events added by an instance encounter.

fields.name: Script
documentation: Source used for events added by Lua scripting APIs. This is used to apply API restrictions; the Pause/Cancel/ResumeScriptEvent functions only work on Script events.

fields.name: EditMode
documentation: Source used for events added by the AddEditModeEvents script API.

tables.name: EncounterTimelineEventState
documentation: Enumeration of all encounter timeline event states.

tables.name: EncounterTimelineTrack
documentation: Enumeration of all encounter timeline tracks., Tracks are not permitted to overlap (but may have a zero duration span), and are contiguously ordered from shortest maximum duration to longest.

fields.name: Short
documentation: This track always has a zero minimum duration.

fields.name: Indeterminate
documentation: This track is used as a placeholder for events whose position is not calculated and shouldn't appear on the timeline.

tables.name: EncounterTimelineTrackType
documentation: Enumeration of all encounter timeline track types. Track types infer behavioral aspects of the track, for example whether or not we associate sort orders to events in the track.

tables.name: EncounterTimelineViewType
documentation: Enumeration of view types for the timeline., View types control layout parameters for the timeline such as maximum track durations and event counts, and optimize event processing for expected display behaviors.

fields.name: None
documentation: Configures the view for an empty timeline display. This mode is recommended for user addons that take full control of the timeline display.

fields.name: Timeline
documentation: Configures the view for a linear timeline display.

fields.name: Bars
documentation: Configures the view for a sorted timer bar display.

fields.name: ENCOUNTER_TIMELINE_INVALID_EVENT
documentation: Constant used for invalid event IDs. Script APIs are guaranteed to always return nil data if supplied this ID, and events will never be added to the timeline with this ID.

fields.name: ENCOUNTER_TIMELINE_RESERVED_EVENT_COUNT
documentation: Minimum size of internal arrays that are preallocated for event storage.
